ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Identity, Subjectivity, and Agency in Art Education. Engage in a theoretical and experiential investigation of the concepts of identity, subjectivity, and agency and their implications for art education. Examine theoretical understandings of identity, subjectivity, and agency in the context of art education through perspectives such as critical race theory, queer theory, feminism, postcolonialism, poststructuralism, and posthumanism. In addition, explore experiential perceptions of identity, subjectivity, and agency within art education through narrative, phenomenological, and arts-based methods.
